meta.title: Buyer uses Smart Awarding and creates the award proposal
gaps: That the created proposal's vendor and quantity allocation exactly reflect the Smart Awarding recommendation.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: That the created proposal's vendor and quantity allocation exactly reflect the Smart Awarding recommendation.

steps.note: Open the completed RFx event on its Master QCS page.
Enter the awarding screen where Smart Awarding and Create Proposal are available.

args.goal: click Smart Awarding, select the Best Value Vendor Selection recommendation, click the blue send icon, and stop when the Procol AI response block showing the suggested awarding plan is visible

steps.note: Perform and visually verify the AI recommendation flow, including the response block.
Create the award proposal after reviewing the AI response.
Verify that proposal creation navigated to the proposal screen.
